_note: PROBE, AND THE REASON IS NOT CONVENIENCE. The fullpage manager reads a
library out of IndexedDB; a fresh demo project has none, so every one of
the five fullpage boards measured in the running app would be measured
against the EMPTY state — which is 1162:4617, a different board. The host
is 1380 x 844, the board's own middle band (1440 less the 60 rail, 900
less the 56 topbar); measuring at the raw viewport would compare a
1440-wide manager against a board that draws 1380. LibraryManager mounts
exactly as it ships — useMediaState and all four sub-hooks run, FolderTree
/ AssetGrid / AssetDetailsPanel are the real components — and the fixture
answers only the composer.media calls those hooks make. The wait names an
ASSET CARD, so an empty library cannot pass as this board.
BOARD WON — the chassis first, and it was wrong by construction:
1159:4641  the middle band is 760, and 52 + 760 + 32 is the board's 844.
`.mgr`'s grid template said 56 / 1fr / 36 while `.mgr-top`
and `.mgr-status` set 52 and 32 on THEMSELVES, so the body
was 752 and eight pixels went to two rows taller than their
own contents. Nothing could see it: each row looked right.
1159:4642  the folder rail is inset 12 on three sides with a 2 gap. Its
horizontal inset was 0 and `.mgr-tree` carried an 8 of its
own, so the rows ran nearly to the rail's edge.
1159:4643  the grid column is inset 16 with a 12 top and a 12 between
blocks; the toolbar and the grid each carried a 20 of their
own instead, and the toolbar drew a rule the board does not.
1159:4645  the status bar sits on --color/bg-subtle with an 8 gap. It
was white with 16, so the band that separates the manager
from the page read as more panel.
BOARD WON — the rail's INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE, which the
media-new-folder-inline note deferred to 'whoever owns the fullpage
boards'. 1160:16 / 1160:27 / 1160:43 name three groups — SMART, FOLDERS,
TAGS — separated by 10-high gaps (1160:26 / 1160:42), with Trash at the
foot. It shipped as a single 'Folders' head over four hairline-separated
blocks: the rail was named after one of its own groups and the smart
folders had no name at all. And 1160:44 draws tags as a wrapped row of
full-radius PILLS, not as a fourth column of rows with counts — a tag is a
filter you scan sideways, and giving it a folder's row shape said it was a
place. `libraryItems` was FolderTree's only remaining use for the tag
counts and is gone from its props with them.
BOARD WON — the card grid. 1161:51 draws five 144-wide cards on a 12
gutter and leaves the slack; the grid's tracks were `minmax(144px, 1fr)`,
which stretched every card to 148, so no card in the product has ever been
the width the board specifies. 1161:52 makes the card a borderless 8-radius
stack on a 6 gap and 1161:53 puts the SELECTION RING on the thumb — the
card's own 1px border was also what made every thumb 142 inside a 144
-> 9 (1161:57), format chips and column chips 8/11 -> 6/9 and 6/10
A BORDER COLOUR THAT COULD NOT BE COMPARED, now it can. `.mgr-top`,
`.mgr-left` and `.mgr-status` each drew ONE edge, which leaves the other
three `border-color`s at `currentColor` — so the computed shorthand is
four different values and the board's single colour cannot be matched
against it at all (the media-new-folder-inline note records giving up on
exactly this). Declaring `border: 0 solid var(--bk-border)` and then one
edge's width renders identically and makes the fact measurable.
CONTRAST — one fixed, three declined. FIXED: the status bar's
'N not on the server' pill was --bk-warning on --bk-warning-tint at
3.51:1; it is --bk-warning-text now (9.9:1), the same swap board 807:8521
forced on the inspector's MARGIN tag. DECLINED: 1160:16 / 1160:27 /
1160:43 name --color/ink-muted for the three rail captions, which measures
4.39:1 on this rail's own --color/bg-subtle ground. Seven instances of
that exact pair were fixed here on 2026-09-08 against board 1205:4829;
re-introducing three would be conforming a defect. The captions keep
--bk-ink-soft (7.0:1) and their nodes are NOT joined, so the deviation is
declared rather than hidden.
NOT JOINED — 1159:4644, the details rail. The board draws a flat 14-inset
column: 160 preview, filename, dimensions, an alt-text box, two version
rows, a used-in line and five action buttons. AssetDetailsPanel is a
bordered head over a preview over a Details/Versions/Used-in TAB BAR. That
is a rebuild of a 450-line component, not a restyle, and its own 320 width
and 760 height ARE right; joining the node would only report a padding
difference that is downstream of a structure this pass is not changing.
1161:123-155 (its children) go with it.
ALSO NOT JOINED: the topbar (1159:4594) and the rail (2034:8392) — other
surfaces own those, and this probe does not mount them. 2865:21954 /
search) is a chrome-ui TextInput, boards.json authority=open:input-fill.
NOT JOINED, three more and each for its own reason:
1160:26  the rail's group gap, w-216. The rail is 240 with a 1px right
edge, so its content box is 215: Figma strokes do not consume
layout and CSS borders do, which the media-no-results note
records as the same arithmetic. Its HEIGHT (10) is what the gap
is for and is built.
1160:44  the tags row, whose only fills are gap 6 and a #ffffff
background. The row sits on the rail's --color/bg-subtle in the
board's own render; a white strip behind three pills on a grey
rail is Figma's default frame fill, not a design. Its gap and
its pills (1160:45) are conformed; 1160:45 IS joined.
1161:53  the FIRST card's thumb, which the board draws selected (accent
border). Nothing is selected in this state, so the second card's
thumb (1161:59) is joined instead — identical but for the ring.
TWO HARNESS CHANGES CAME OUT OF THIS SURFACE, both widenings rather than
loosenings. (1) `parse()` in measure.mjs read only rgb()/rgba(), so every
Tailwind opacity-modifier fill — which v4 emits as `oklab(... / 0.6)` — was
read as NO FILL and composited past; it fabricated eight white-on-white
failures on the media picker and would have hidden a real one anywhere
else. It rasterises through a 1x1 canvas now. (2) `PILL` in lib.mjs folded
at 9999, and boards in this file author the same intent as 999 — 1160:58's
quota track is 5px tall on a 999 radius, which is a pill by any reading —
so a pixel-identical shape reported a 9000px difference. The fold starts at
999; nothing in this system asks for a literal radius in between.
CONTRAST STILL OPEN AND DECLARED — `.mgr-kind`, the ▶/◆/Aa file-kind badge
on a thumb, at 3.99:1. Board 1161:66 pins it: white on --color/bg-overlay
rgba(17,24,39,0.5). The ratio is a function of what is BEHIND the scrim, and
the fixture's thumb is a light grey placeholder — over a dark photograph the
same badge passes comfortably. Fixing it means a scrim darker than the token
the board names, which is a founder call, so it is baselined with the pair
recorded rather than silently.
